## Classes

### `class AsyncByteSource`

Immutable-revision asynchronous byte access. Returned arrays transfer ownership to the caller.

| --- | --- | --- |
| `readRange` | `async readRange(start, end, { signal = this._signal } = {})` |  |
| `stream` | `stream({ start = 0, end = this.size, chunkBytes = ASYNC_BYTE_PAGE_BYTES, signal = this._signal } = {})` |  |

| `fromVault` | `static fromVault(store, { size, revision, headToken, prefix = '', resolvePage = null, pageBytes = ASYNC_BYTE_PAGE_BYTES, ...options } = {})` |  |
| `dispose` | `dispose()` |  |
